description: One CamPay application. Saving it creates the CamPay-<Gateway Name> payment gateway. Payments are in XAF only.

fields.description: Cannot be changed once saved: the payment gateway is named after it.
fields.label: Gateway Name

fields.description: A disabled gateway refuses new payments.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Switching it moves the API Base URL to the other CamPay address while it still holds a default one. A Production gateway with a webhook key needs an https:// host_name.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Must be an https:// address: the access token is sent to it.
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: The application's Permanent Access Token, from API ACCESS KEYS in the CamPay dashboard.
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: The App Webhook Key, from API ACCESS KEYS. Leave it empty to refuse every webhook call: status checks still settle payments.
fields.label: Webhook Key

fields.description: Enter this address as the webhook in the CamPay dashboard, with GET or POST. Built from the site's host_name on save. The webhook only triggers a status check.
fields.label: Webhook URL

fields.description: With both operators checked, the payer chooses on the payment page.
fields.label: Accept MTN MoMo

fields.description: Sent to CamPay and shown to the payer. {title} is replaced by the payment's title. Never put a phone number or personal data in it.
fields.label: Payment Description

fields.description: How long a request may stay pending before the attempt is marked Unresolved.
fields.label: Pending Timeout (Minutes)

fields.description: Smallest amount in XAF a payment request can ask for.
fields.label: Minimum Amount

fields.description: Largest amount in XAF a payment request can ask for. 0 means no limit. The CamPay sandbox refuses more than 100.
fields.label: Maximum Amount

name: CamPay Settings
